# Luxora Villa

> Luxury 3-bedroom private-pool villa in Pereybere, Grand Baie, North Mauritius. Rated 9.3/10 on Booking.com.

Luxora Villa is a brand-new holiday villa rental with private pool, jacuzzi and rooftop terrace, minutes from Pereybere Beach and Grand Baie's restaurants, shops and nightlife. Sleeps up to 6 guests across 3 air-conditioned bedrooms.

## Booking

- Rates are quoted per enquiry (they vary by dates and length of stay). Send dates and guest count via /contact or WhatsApp.
- [Book on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/hotel/mu/3-bedrooms-villa-in-pereybere.en-gb.html): Verified reviews and best-price guarantee.
- WhatsApp: +230 5922 6558

## Location

Pereybere, Grand Baie, North Mauritius. 75 minutes from Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam International Airport (MRU).
